title: A coherent method for combined stable magnesium and radiogenic strontium isotope analyses in carbonates (with application to geological reference materials SARM 40, SARM 43, SRM 88A, SRM 1B)
author: Stammeier, Nebel, et al.

steps.title: Clean beakers and labware
steps.instruction: Boil Savillex® or AHF® PFA beakers in 5 mol L⁻¹ HNO₃ at 120 °C for at least 24 h, then in 6 mol L⁻¹ HCl at 120 °C for at least 24 h; clean all other lab equipment (PE bottles, pipette tips) in 0.8 mol L⁻¹ HNO₃ at 60 °C for at least 48 h.

substeps.instruction: Place beakers in 5 M HNO₃, heat to 120 °C, maintain ≥24 h.
Transfer beakers to 6 M HCl, heat to 120 °C, maintain ≥24 h.
Immerse PE bottles and pipette tips in 0.8 M HNO₃, heat to 60 °C, maintain ≥48 h.

steps.title: Purify acids by sub‑boiling
steps.instruction: Distill both HNO₃ and HCl (pro‑analysis grade) twice using a PFA Savillex® DST‑1000 sub‑boiling distillation system; verify that blanks are < 50 ng L⁻¹ for Mg and Sr.

steps.title: Dilute purified acids
steps.instruction: Dilute the purified acids with MilliQ® water (18.2 MΩ·cm, 25 °C, TOC < 5 ng mL⁻¹).

steps.title: Clean and store ion‑exchange resins
steps.instruction: Rinse ion‑exchange resins sequentially with MilliQ® water and 1 mol L⁻¹ HNO₃ or HCl (as appropriate), then store the resins in MilliQ® water.

steps.title: Assemble and condition Mg column
steps.instruction: Use a polypropylene column (5 cm length, 0.5 mm inner diameter) loaded with 1 mL BioRad® AG50 × 12 resin and a 5 mL reservoir; clean the column and resin with several millilitres of both 5 M HNO₃ and 6 M HCl, rinsing between each acid step with several column volumes of MilliQ® water.

substeps.instruction: Load 1 mL AG50 × 12 resin into the column.
Add a 5 mL reservoir to the column.
Flush the column with several mL of 5 M HNO₃.
Rinse with several column volumes of MilliQ® water.
Flush with several mL of 6 M HCl.
Rinse again with several column volumes of MilliQ® water.

steps.title: Assemble and condition Sr column
steps.instruction: Prepare a fresh column for each Sr separation; clean the column and its polyethylene frit in 0.45 mol L⁻¹ HNO₃, then store the assembled column in MilliQ® water until use.

steps.title: Digest samples and perform ion‑exchange
steps.instruction: Carry out sample digestion and the ion‑exchange chromatographic separation of Mg²⁺ and Sr²⁺ inside a laminar flow hood using the cleaned beakers and the prepared Mg and Sr columns.
